in_marathi.name: Pankj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pankj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'pankaj' meaning 'lotus' and 'kaja' meaning 'lord of'. In Hindu mythology, Pankj is the name of a deity associated with wealth, prosperity, and abundance. He is often depicted as a lotus flower with many petals and is worshipped for financial success and material comfort.
